_comment: Pretty display name overrides for the bundled-sample picker. Keys are file stems (filename without extension); values are the display string the picker shows. Filenames without an entry here fall back to mirror_from_ios.py's auto-transform: lowercase-kebab → Title Case (so 'phi-drone' → 'Phi Drone'), CamelCase / already-spaced names pass through untouched. Add an entry whenever you want a specific override (e.g. em-dash, punctuation, branded casing).
